name: state-window-else-key-absent-z
reference: spec 0.33 Encode and ruling 12: the plain `when` writes 01, bits of no held key, and windows settle before a switch reads its key back; ruling 9 of 0.52; x is absent: 01 does not match, so the window writes its first value 2: case 2, y (zero bits); z is of another case
